description: Lightweight FastAPI + Next.js marketplace with buyer cart, seller products, mock checkout, and Docker Compose.

notes: The upstream compose file publishes backend on 8000, frontend on 3000, and nginx on 80.
The eval overlay supplies development .env files so Docker Compose can start without manual setup.
Best initial target for one-time Checkout and Connect marketplace flows.
The existing app has mock payment/order code, so agents should replace or extend that path rather than building a separate toy server.
